final: WITH a AS (SELECT AlbumId, SUM(Bytes)*1.0/SUM(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN Milliseconds END) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), m AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS mean_rate FROM a WHERE rate IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(a.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(a.n) AS avg_track_count, AVG(a.rate - m.mean_rate) AS avg_excess_over_mean FROM a, m WHERE a.rate > m.mean_rate
